message.content:
The screenshot shows a mobile browser view of the "GUDSTOR PACK" website (URL: or-pack.vercel.app).  

### Product Cards:  
No, **product cards are not showing** in the visible area. The main content area displays a placeholder icon (a box graphic) instead of product cards, indicating the product listing is either still loading or empty for the current filter.  


### Spacing:  
The spacing appears **uneven** in the product section:  
- The area above the placeholder (where product cards would typically appear) has empty space, while the placeholder itself is centered with surrounding whitespace.  
- The layout of filters (e.g., “Categorías 2,” “Nombre A-Z,” and the “Films ×”/“Negro ×” tags) has inconsistent vertical/horizontal spacing relative to the placeholder and other elements.  


Additional context: The page is filtered to “Films” and “Negro” (with 6 products available, per the text), but the product cards are not rendered in the visible portion of the screen.
